This is love: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the sacrifice that takes away our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us that much, we should love one another too.
No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us, and His love is made complete in us.
We know we live in Him and He lives in us, because He has given us His Spirit.
We have seen and tell others that the Father sent His Son to save the world.
If anyone says that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him, and he lives in God.
We have known and believed the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever stays in love stays in God, and God stays in him.
Love is made complete among us so that we can be brave on the day of judgment. We can be brave because in this world we are like Him.
There is no fear in love. Perfect love throws fear out, because fear brings punishment. The person who is afraid has not been made complete in love.
We love because He first loved us.
If someone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. The person who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
We have this command from Him: Anyone who loves God must also love his brother.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves God also loves the one born of Him.
This is how we know that we love God's children: when we love God and keep His commandments.
For loving God means keeping His commandments, and His commandments are not hard to carry.
For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world—our faith.
Who can overcome the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
This is the One who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And the Spirit is the One who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
For there are three that testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. These three agree as one.
If we accept human testimony, God's testimony is greater, because God has testified about His Son.
The one who believes in the Son of God has this testimony in himself. The one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed the testimony God gave about His Son.
And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
The one who has the Son has life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
This is the confidence we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
And if we know that He hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we already have what we asked of Him.

If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin that does not lead to death, he should ask, and God will give him life. This applies to those who sin in a way that does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should pray about that.
All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin that does not lead to death.
We know that everyone born of God does not keep on sinning. The One born of God protects him, and the evil one does not touch him.
We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know the true One. We are in the true One—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children. I love them in the truth. I am not the only one—everyone who knows the truth loves them too.
We love them because the truth stays in us and will be with us forever.
Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son. They will stay with us in truth and love.
I was very glad to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
Now I ask you, lady, not to write a new command for you, but to remember the command we have had from the start: love one another.
This is love: walk by His commands. This is the command you have heard from the start, so you should walk in it.
Many deceivers have gone out into the world. They do not admit that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Anyone like that is a deceiver and an antichrist.
Watch yourselves so you do not lose what we worked for. Instead, you should receive a full reward.
Everyone who runs ahead and does not stay in Christ's teaching does not have God. The person who stays in that teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house, and do not even greet him.
Anyone who greets him shares in his evil deeds.
I have a lot to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. I hope to visit you and talk face to face, so our joy will be complete.
The children of your chosen sister send their greetings to you.
The elder writes to Gaius, the one I love and who is dear to me, whom I love in the truth.
Dear friend, I pray that you may do well in every way and stay healthy, just as your soul is doing well.
I was very glad when some fellow believers came and told me how faithful you are to the truth and how you live by it.
I have no greater joy than hearing that my children are living in the truth.
Dear friend, you are faithful in what you do for the brothers, even for those you do not know.
They told the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a way that honors God.
They went out for the sake of the Name and took nothing from non-believers.
So we should welcome people like them, so that we can work together for the truth.
I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept us.

So if I come, I will point out what he is doing. He talks nonsense and says evil things about us, and he is not satisfied with that. He will not welcome the brothers, he stops those who want to welcome them, and he throws them out of the church.
Dear friend, do not copy what is evil, but copy what is good. The one who does good belongs to God, but the one who does evil has never seen God.
Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and the truth itself speaks well of him. We also speak well of him, and you know our words are true.
I have much more to write to you, but I do not want to use pen and ink.
I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk face to face. Peace to you. The friends send you their greetings. Greet the friends for me by name.
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, writes to those who are called, who are loved by God the Father and kept in Jesus Christ.
Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
Dear friends, while I was trying hard to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt I had to write and urge you to fight for the faith that God gave His holy people once and for all.

Some people have slipped in among you without notice. They were marked long ago for judgment. They are ungodly people who take God's grace and use it as an excuse to live wildly, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
I want to remind you, even though you already know all this, that Jesus saved a people out of Egypt but later destroyed those who did not believe.
And the angels who did not stay in their proper place but left their own home, He has kept in everlasting chains under darkness for judgment on the great day.
Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby cities gave themselves to sexual immorality and pursued unnatural desires, they stand as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.
In the same way, these dreamers pollute their bodies, reject authority, and speak evil of glorious beings.
But Michael the archangel, when he argued with the devil about Moses' body, did not dare to accuse him with insulting words. Instead, he said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
But these people speak evil of things they do not understand. Like animals that act without thinking, they are destroyed by the things they know by instinct.
Woe to them! They have followed Cain's path. They have rushed into Balaam's error for money. They have been destroyed in Korah's rebellion.

These people are hidden reefs at your love feasts. They eat with you without fear, caring only for themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown by the wind. They are autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots.
They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame. They are wandering stars, and the blackest darkness is reserved for them forever.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about these people. He said, "Look, the Lord is coming with thousands of His holy ones
to judge everyone and to convict all ungodly people of every ungodly thing they have done, and of all the harsh words ungodly sinners have spoken against Him."
These people are grumblers and complainers. They follow their own evil desires. They speak proud words and flatter others to get what they want.
But you, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said before.
They told you, "In the last days, mockers will come who follow their own ungodly desires."
These people cause divisions. They follow their natural desires and do not have the Spirit.
But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in God's love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.
Have mercy on those who doubt.
Save others by snatching them from the fire. Have mercy on others with fear, hating even the clothes stained by sin.
Now to Him who can keep you from falling and present you blameless before His glorious presence with great joy,
to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
who testified to everything he saw—the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and keep what is written in it, because the time is near.
John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by His blood,
and has made us a kingdom and priests to serve His God and Father—to Him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
Look, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him; and all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. Yes! Amen.
"I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."
I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering, kingdom, and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
On the Lord's Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
which said, "Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
I turned around to see who was speaking to me. And when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.
And among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a robe reaching down to His feet and with a golden sash around His chest.
The hair on His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like blazing fire.
His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and His voice was like the sound of rushing waters.
In His right hand He held seven stars, and a sharp, double-edged sword came out of His mouth. His face was like the sun shining in all its strength.
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet as though dead. Then He placed His right hand on me and said, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.
I am the Living One; I was dead, and now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.
Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.

The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."
To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: "These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
"I know your deeds, your hard work, and your patient endurance. I know you cannot tolerate wicked people. You have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and you have found them false.
You have persevered and endured hardships for My name, and you have not grown weary.
"Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.
"So remember how far you have fallen. Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
"But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
"Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God."
To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: "These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.
"I know your suffering and your poverty, yet you are rich. I also know the slander from those who say they are Jews but are not. They are a synagogue of Satan.

Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.
"Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be hurt at all by the second death."
To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: "These are the words of the One who has the sharp, double-edged sword.

"I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to My name. You did not renounce your faith in Me, even in the days of Antipas, My faithful witness, who was put to death in your city, where Satan lives.

But I have a few things against you: You have there some who hold to the teaching of Balaam. He taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin by eating food sacrificed to idols and by committing sexual immorality.
"In the same way, you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So repent! Otherwise, I will come to you soon and fight against them with the sword of My mouth.

"Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it."
To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: "These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
"I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, and your patient endurance. I also know that your recent deeds are greater than your first ones.
But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants into sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.
"I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.
So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of what they have done.
"I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am He who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to those who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned what some call the deep things of Satan: I will not impose any other burden on you.
"Just hold on to what you have until I come.
"To the one who overcomes and keeps My works to the end, I will give authority over the nations.
He will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.
I will also give that one the morning star.
"Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
"To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds. You have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.
Wake up and strengthen what is left, because it is about to die. I have not found your deeds complete before My God.
So remember what you received and heard. Keep it and turn back to Me. If you do not stay awake, I will come like a thief, and you will not know when I will come to you.
"Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not stained their clothes. They will walk with Me in white, because they are worthy.
The one who overcomes will be dressed in white. I will not erase his name from the Book of Life, and I will acknowledge his name before My Father and before His angels.
"The one who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
"To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things says the Holy and True One, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
I know your deeds. Look, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. You have little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
Look, I will make those who belong to Satan's synagogue—people who say they are Jews but are not, because they lie—come and bow down at your feet. Then they will know that I have loved you.
"Because you kept My command to endure, I will also keep you from the time of testing that is coming on the whole world, to test those who live on the earth.
Look, I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so no one takes your crown.

The one who overcomes, I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never leave it. I will write on him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down from heaven from My God. I will also write on him My new name.
"The one who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
"To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things says the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God's creation.
I know your deeds. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were one or the other.
So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of My mouth.
"You say, 'I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.' But you do not know that you are miserable, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
I advise you to buy from Me gold refined by fire, so you can be truly rich. Buy white clothes so your shameful nakedness will not show. Also buy eye medicine to put on your eyes so you can see.
I correct and train everyone I love. So be eager and turn back to Me.
"Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with him, and he will eat with Me.
To the one who overcomes, I will give the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
"The one who has an ear should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
After this, I looked and saw an open door in heaven. The voice I had heard before sounded like a trumpet and spoke to me. It said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this."
At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
The One sitting there looked like jasper and carnelian stone. A rainbow surrounded the throne and looked like an emerald.
Around the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on them sat twenty-four elders. They wore white clothes and had gold crowns on their heads.
Lightning, sounds, and thunder came from the throne. In front of the throne, seven burning lamps blazed. These are the seven Spirits of God.
In front of the throne was something like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures covered with eyes in front and behind.
The first looked like a lion, the second like a young bull, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth looked like a flying eagle.

Each of the four creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and inside. Day and night they never stopped saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, and is, and is to come!"
Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, the One who lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne. They worship the One who lives forever and ever, and they throw their crowns down before the throne, saying,
"Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory, honor, and power, because You created all things. By Your will they existed and were created."
I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One sitting on the throne. It was written on the inside and the outside, and it was sealed with seven seals.
I also saw a strong angel shouting in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
But no one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.
I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not cry. Look! The Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won the victory. He can open the scroll and its seven seals.”

Then I saw a Lamb standing in the middle of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. He looked like He had been killed. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One sitting on the throne.

When He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s holy people.
They sang a new song: “You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were killed. With Your blood You bought people for God from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
You made them a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will rule on the earth.”
Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. Their number was thousands and thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand.
They said in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise!”

Then I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To the One sitting on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing, honor, glory, and power forever and ever!”
The four living creatures said, “Amen!” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"
I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider held a bow and was given a crown. He rode out to win, and he will keep on winning.
When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
Then another horse came out, bright red. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth so that people would kill each other. He was also given a large sword.
When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" I looked, and there was a black horse. Its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.
Then I heard a voice from among the four living creatures say, "A quart of wheat costs a full day's pay, and three quarts of barley cost a full day's pay. But do not harm the olive oil and the wine."
When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"

I looked, and there was a pale horse. Its rider was named Death, and Hades followed close behind. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill people with swords, hunger, plague, and wild animals.
When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of people who had been killed because they stayed true to God's word and to their testimony.
They cried out in a loud voice, "How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge the people living on the earth and punish them for killing us?"

Each of them was given a white robe. They were told to rest a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants and brothers and sisters who were to be killed, just as they had been, was complete.
I watched as the Lamb opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like rough cloth, and the whole moon turned red like blood.
The stars in the sky fell to the earth, like green figs dropping from a fig tree shaken by a strong wind.
The sky split apart like a scroll being rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved from its place.
Then the kings of the earth, the great leaders, the army commanders, the rich, the powerful, and every slave and free person hid themselves in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
They called out to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb,
because the great day of Their anger has come. Who can stand?"
After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. They held back the earth's four winds so no wind could blow on the land, sea, or any tree.
Then I saw another angel coming up from the east. He had the seal of the living God, and he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and sea:
"Do not harm the land, sea, or trees until we seal the foreheads of the servants of our God."
And I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from every tribe of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah, 12,000 were sealed; from Reuben, 12,000; and from Gad, 12,000.
From Asher, 12,000; from Naphtali, 12,000; and from Manasseh, 12,000.
From Simeon, 12,000; from Levi, 12,000; and from Issachar, 12,000.
From Zebulun, 12,000; from Joseph, 12,000; and from Benjamin, 12,000.

After this I looked, and I saw a great crowd that no one could count. It came from every nation, tribe, people, and language. They stood before the throne and before the Lamb, wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
They cried out in a loud voice, "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
All the angels stood around the throne, along with the elders and the four living creatures. They fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God.
They said, "Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen."
Then one of the elders asked me, "Who are these people in white robes, and where did they come from?"
I said to him, "Sir, you know."Then he said, "These are the ones who have come out of the great suffering. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Because of this, they are before the throne of God. They serve Him day and night in His temple. And the One who sits on the throne will shelter them.
They will never be hungry or thirsty again. The sun will not beat down on them, and neither will any scorching heat.
For the Lamb at the center of the throne will shepherd them. He will lead them to springs of living water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all God's holy people on the golden altar before the throne.
The smoke of the incense rose with the prayers of God's holy people to God from the angel's hand.
Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. There were thunder, loud sounds, lightning, and an earthquake.
The seven angels with the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.
The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood came down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood.
A third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The star's name is Wormwood, and a third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood. Many people died because the waters had become bitter.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. So a third of them went dark, and a third of the day did not shine, and the night was the same.

I looked and heard an eagle flying in the middle of the sky. It called out in a loud voice, "Woe! Woe! Woe to those who live on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts that the other three angels are about to sound!"
When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.
He opened the pit, and smoke rose from it like smoke from a huge furnace. The sun and the air grew dark because of the smoke.
Locusts came out of the smoke and went down to the earth. They were given power like the power of scorpions on the earth.
They were told not to harm the grass, the green plants, or the trees. They could hurt only people who did not have God's seal on their foreheads.
They were not allowed to kill those people. Instead, they were to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the sting of a scorpion.
In those days, people will look for death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will run away from them.
The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. They seemed to wear crowns that looked like gold on their heads, and their faces looked like human faces.
Their hair looked like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.
They had chest armor that looked like iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
They had tails with stings like scorpions. Their tails had the power to hurt people for five months.
They had a king over them: the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.
The first woe has passed. Look, two more woes are still coming.
The sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice come from the four horns of the golden altar that stands before God.
The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are tied up at the great river Euphrates."
So the four angels were released. They had been kept ready for that hour, day, month, and year. They were released to kill one-third of all people.
I heard the number of the horsemen in the armies: two hundred million.

In the vision, I saw the horses and their riders. They wore chest armor that was red like fire, blue, and yellow like sulfur. The horses' heads looked like lions' heads. Fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
One-third of all people were killed by these three plagues: the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that came out of the horses' mouths.
The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes with heads, and they used them to hurt people.

The rest of the people, who were not killed by these plagues, still did not turn from their evil deeds. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Those idols cannot see, hear, or walk.
They also did not turn from their murders, their magic, their sexual sins, or their thefts.
I saw another powerful angel coming down from heaven. He was wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire.
He held a small scroll that was open in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
He shouted in a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he shouted, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders said, and do not write it down."
The angel I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand toward heaven.
He swore by the One who lives forever and ever, who made heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it. He swore that there would be no more delay.
But in the days when the seventh angel is about to blow his trumpet, the mystery of God will be finished, just as He announced to His servants the prophets.
Then the voice I heard from heaven spoke to me again. It said, "Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land."
So I went to the angel and said to him, "Give me the little scroll." He told me, "Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet like honey."
I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it. It was sweet like honey in my mouth, but after I ate it, my stomach turned bitter.
Then they told me, "You must prophesy again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."
I was given a measuring rod like a staff. A voice said, "Get up and measure God's temple, the altar, and the people who worship there.
But leave out the outer courtyard of the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations. They will trample the holy city for forty-two months."
I will give power to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days while wearing sackcloth.
These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
If anyone tries to hurt them, fire comes from their mouths and burns up their enemies. Anyone who tries to hurt them must be killed.

They have power to shut the sky so no rain falls during the days they prophesy. They also have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
When they finish their testimony, the beast that comes up from the bottomless pit will fight against them. It will defeat them and kill them.
Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city. That city is called Sodom and Egypt in a spiritual sense, because that is where their Lord was crucified.
For three and a half days, people from every nation, tribe, language, and people will look at their bodies. They will not allow the bodies to be put in a tomb.
The people who live on the earth will be glad about this. They will celebrate and send gifts to one another, because these two prophets made life hard for everyone on earth.
After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them. They stood up on their feet, and great fear fell on everyone who saw them.
Then they heard a loud voice from heaven say, "Come up here." They went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.
At that same hour, there was a great earthquake. A tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. The rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second woe has passed. Look, the third woe is coming soon.
The seventh angel blew his trumpet, and loud voices spoke in heaven. They said, "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever."
The twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God.
They said, "We thank You, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and begun to reign.

The nations were angry, but Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, the holy people, and everyone who fears Your name, both small and great. It is also time to destroy those who destroy the earth."
Then God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple. There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman was clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.
Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.
Its tail swept a third of the stars from the sky and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so it could eat her child as soon as she had it.
She gave birth to a son, a boy who will rule all the nations with an iron rod. Her child was snatched up to God and to His throne.
The woman ran away into the wilderness, to a place God had prepared for her. There she would receive care for 1,260 days.
Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
But the dragon was not strong enough, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down. He is the old serpent called the devil, or Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say, “Now salvation and power and the kingdom of our God have come, and the authority of His Christ has come. For the accuser of our brothers, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been thrown down.
They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. They did not love their lives so much that they were afraid of death.
So rejoice, you heavens and you who live in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you! He is very angry, because he knows he has only a short time.”
When the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he chased the woman who had given birth to the boy.
The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so she could fly to her place in the wilderness, away from the serpent. There she would receive care for three and a half years.
The serpent poured water from his mouth like a river, chasing the woman, to sweep her away in the flood.
But the earth helped the woman. It opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
The dragon was angry with the woman. He went away to make war against the rest of her children, who obey God's commands and hold to the testimony of Jesus. Then he stood on the shore of the sea.
I saw a beast come up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads. On its horns were ten crowns, and on its heads were names that insulted God.
The beast I saw looked like a leopard. Its feet were like a bear's feet, and its mouth was like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave the beast his power, his throne, and great authority.
One of the beast's heads looked as if it had been killed, but its deadly wound was healed. The whole world was amazed by the beast and followed it.
People worshiped the dragon because he gave authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?"
The beast was given a mouth that spoke proud and insulting words. It was given authority to act for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to insult God. It insulted His name, His home, and those who live in heaven.
It was allowed to make war against God's holy people and defeat them. It was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
Everyone living on earth will worship it. This means everyone whose name has not been written, since the world was made, in the book of life that belongs to the Lamb who was killed.
If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
If anyone is meant to be captured, he will be captured. If anyone is to be killed by the sword, he will be killed by the sword. This calls for patient endurance and faith from God's holy people.
Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb's horns, but it spoke like a dragon.
It uses all the authority of the first beast while the first beast watches. It makes the earth and everyone living on it worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
It performs great signs. It even makes fire come down from heaven to earth while people watch.
It deceives the people living on earth by the signs it is allowed to do in front of the first beast. It tells them to make an image for the beast that was wounded by the sword but lived.
It was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so the image could speak. It could also cause anyone who does not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
It forces everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.
No one can buy or sell unless he has the mark. The mark is either the name of the beast or the number of its name.
This calls for wisdom. The person who understands should count the number of the beast. It is a human number. Its number is 666.
Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, with 144,000 people who had His name and His Father's name written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like harpists playing their harps.
And they sang a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures, and before the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been bought from the earth.

These are the ones who did not make themselves impure with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They were bought from among people as the firstfruits offered to God and the Lamb.
No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
Then I saw another angel flying in midair, with the eternal good news to announce to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give Him glory, because the time for His judgment has come. Worship the One who made heaven, earth, the sea, and the springs of water."
A second angel followed and said, "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great, which made all the nations drink the wine of her furious sexual sin."
A third angel followed them and called out in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,
they too will drink the wine of God's fury, poured full strength into the cup of His wrath. They will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
The smoke of their torment will rise forever and ever. Day and night they will have no rest—those who worship the beast and its image, or anyone who receives the mark of its name."
This calls for patient endurance from God's people, who keep God's commands and stay faithful to Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their hard work, for their deeds will follow them."
I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was someone like a Son of Man. He wore a crown of gold on His head and held a sharp sickle in His hand.

Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, "Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

Still another angel, who had authority over the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to the one with the sharp sickle, "Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe."
The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes, and threw them into the great winepress of God's wrath.
They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses' bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
Then I saw another great and amazing sign in heaven: seven angels holding the seven last plagues. God’s anger is completed in them.
I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Those who had won the victory over the beast, its image, and the number of its name were standing on that glassy sea. They had God’s harps.
They sang the song of God’s servant Moses and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and amazing are Your works, Lord God Almighty! Fair and true are Your ways, King of the nations!
Who will not fear, Lord, and give glory to Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, because Your right actions have been shown.”
After this I looked, and the temple of the tent of witness was opened in heaven.
The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple. They were dressed in clean, bright linen and wore gold sashes around their chests.
One of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven gold bowls. The bowls were full of the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.
The temple was filled with smoke from God’s glory and power. No one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
And I heard a loud voice from the temple. It said to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's wrath on the earth."
The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and ugly, painful sores broke out on the people who had the beast's mark and worshiped its image.
The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like a dead man's blood. Every living thing in the sea died.
The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
Then I heard the angel of the waters say, "You are righteous, O Holy One, who is and who was, because You have judged these things.
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink. They deserve it."
And I heard the altar say, "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments."
The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.
The people were scorched by the terrible heat. They cursed the name of God, who has power over these plagues, but they did not repent and give Him glory.
The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People chewed their tongues in pain.
They cursed the God of heaven because of their pain and sores, but they did not repent of their deeds.
The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
Then I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast, and the mouth of the false prophet.
They are spirits of demons. They do miracles and go out to the kings of the whole world to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
"Look, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes, so he will not walk around naked and people see his shame."
They gathered the kings at the place called Armageddon in Hebrew.
The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, "It is done!"
Then there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a huge earthquake. It was the worst earthquake ever since people have been on the earth.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. God remembered Babylon the Great and made her drink from the cup of the wine of His furious wrath.
Every island fled away, and no mountains were found.
Huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell from heaven on the people. They cursed God because of the terrible plague of hail, for it was very severe.
Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke to me. He said, “Come, you must see the punishment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters.
The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the people who live on earth got drunk on the wine of her immorality.”
He carried me away in the Spirit to a desert, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast. The beast was full of names that insult God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.

The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and she wore gold, precious stones, and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, full of detestable things and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.
On her forehead a name was written: MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE DETESTABLE THINGS OF THE EARTH.
I saw the woman drunk with the blood of God’s holy people and with the blood of those who died for Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly amazed.
The angel said to me, “Why are you amazed? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, the one with seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw was, and is not, and is about to come up out of the bottomless pit and go to destruction. The people living on earth whose names have not been written in the Book of Life since the world was made will be amazed when they see the beast, because it was, and is not, and yet will come.
This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains where the woman sits.
They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must remain for a little while.”
“The beast that was, and is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven, and he goes to destruction.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but for one hour they will receive power as kings along with the beast.
They have one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
They will make war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will overcome them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings. Those with Him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
Then he said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The ten horns and the beast you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her ruined and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”
“For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose. They will agree to give their kingdom to the beast until God’s words are fulfilled.
The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was bright with his glory.

He called out with a loud voice, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a home for demons, a prison for every unclean spirit, a cage for every unclean bird, and a cage for every hated beast.”
For all the nations have drunk the wine of her passionate sexual sin, the kings of the earth committed sexual sin with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her costly luxury.
Then I heard another voice from heaven say, “Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins and so that you will not receive her plagues,
for her sins have piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.
Pay her back as she has paid, and double her penalty to match her deeds. Mix a double portion for her in the cup she mixed.
Give her as much torment and grief as she gave herself glory and luxury, because in her heart she says, ‘I sit as a queen; I am not a widow, and I will never see grief.’
Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death, mourning, and famine—and she will be burned with fire, because the Lord God who judges her is strong.”
The kings of the earth who committed sexual sin and lived in luxury with her will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning.
They will stand far away because they fear her torment, and they will say, “Woe, woe to the great city, the strong city, Babylon! For in one hour your judgment has come.”
The merchants of the earth also weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore:

cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, all kinds of citron wood, all kinds of ivory goods, all kinds of goods made from the finest wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
and cinnamon, spice, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and human souls.
“The fruit your soul longed for has left you; all your rich and splendid things are lost, and they will never be found again.”
The merchants who grew rich from her will stand far away because they fear her torment. They will weep and mourn,
saying, “Woe, woe to the great city, dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decorated with gold, precious stones, and pearls!
For in one hour such great wealth has been ruined.” And every ship captain, every sailor, and all who work at sea stood far away.
They cried out when they saw the smoke of her burning, “What city is like the great city?”
They threw dust on their heads, weeping and mourning, and cried out, “Woe, woe to the great city, where everyone who had ships on the sea grew rich from her wealth! For in one hour she was ruined.”
Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints, apostles, and prophets, because God has avenged you against her.

Then a strong angel picked up a stone like a huge millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “In the same way Babylon the great city will be thrown down with force, and it will not be found anymore.

The sound of harp players, musicians, flute players, and trumpet players will never be heard in you again. No craftsman of any trade will be found in you again, and the sound of a mill will never be heard in you again.

The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voice of bride and groom will never be heard in you again, because your merchants were the great men of the earth, because all nations were led astray by your sorcery.”
In her was found the blood of prophets and saints and of all who were killed on the earth.
After this I heard what sounded like a loud voice from a huge crowd in heaven. They said, “Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God.”
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual sin, and He has punished her for the blood of His servants.
A second time they said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
Then the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who sits on the throne. They said, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
Then a voice came from the throne, saying, “Praise our God, all you His servants, and all who fear Him, both small and great.”
I heard what sounded like a loud voice from a huge crowd, like the roar of many waters and like strong thunder. They said, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.
Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him glory, because the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
She was given fine linen to wear, bright and clean. The fine linen stands for the righteous acts of God's holy people.”
Then the angel said to me, “Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.” And he said, “These are the true words of God.”

I fell at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, “Don't do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony about Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
Then I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True, and He judges and makes war with justice.
His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on His head are many crowns. He has a name written that no one knows except Himself.
He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is called the Word of God.
The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and clean, were following Him on white horses.
From His mouth comes a sharp sword, so that with it He can strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod, and He will tread the winepress of the furious wrath of God the Almighty.
On His robe and on His thigh He has this name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
Then I saw an angel standing in the sun. He called out in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
so that you may eat the flesh of kings, generals, mighty men, horses and riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, small and great.”
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to make war against the rider on the horse and His army.

But the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who had performed the signs in his presence. He had used these signs to deceive those who received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
The rest were killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
I saw an angel coming down from heaven. He held the key to the Abyss and a large chain in his hand.
He grabbed the dragon, that old serpent, who is the devil and Satan. He bound him for a thousand years.
He threw him into the Abyss. Then he locked and sealed it over him. This kept him from tricking the nations until the thousand years ended. After that, he must be free for a short time.

I saw thrones, and people sat on them. They were given power to judge. I also saw the souls of people who were killed for telling about Jesus and for God's word. They had not worshiped the beast or its image. They had not taken its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and ruled with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were over. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ. They will rule with Him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are over, Satan will be let out of his prison.
He will go out to trick the nations in the four corners of the earth. These are Gog and Magog. He will gather them for battle. Their number will be like the sand of the sea.
They marched across the earth and surrounded the camp of God's people and the city He loves. Fire came down from heaven and burned them up.
The devil who tricked them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur. The beast and the false prophet were already there. They will be tortured day and night forever.
Then I saw a great white throne and the One sitting on it. Earth and heaven ran away from Him. No place was found for them.

I saw the dead, both great and small, standing before the throne. Books were opened. Another book was opened too. It is the book of life. The dead were judged by what they had done. It was written in the books.
The sea gave up its dead. Death and Hades gave up their dead. Each person was judged by what they had done.
Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This lake of fire is the second death.
Anyone whose name was not found in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth were gone, and there was no more sea.
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God. It was ready like a bride dressed for her husband.
I heard a loud voice from the throne say, “Look, God’s home is with people. He will live with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be their God.
He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, sadness, crying, or pain. The old things are gone.”
The One sitting on the throne said, “Look, I am making everything new.” Then He said, “Write this down, because these words are true and can be trusted.”
He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give free water from the spring of life to anyone who is thirsty.”
“The one who wins the victory will receive all this. I will be his God, and he will be My son.”

“But cowards, people who do not believe, those who do terrible things, murderers, those who sin sexually, those who use magic, idol worshipers, and all liars will have their place in the lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death.”
Then one of the seven angels came to me. He had the seven bowls full of the last seven plagues. He said, “Come, and I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
He carried me in the Spirit to a great, high mountain. He showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
The city had God’s glory. It shone like a very precious jewel, like jasper, clear as crystal.
It had a great, high wall with twelve gates. Twelve angels stood at the gates. The names of the twelve tribes of Israel were written on the gates.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The city wall had twelve foundations. On them were the twelve names of the Lamb’s apostles.
The angel who talked with me had a gold measuring rod. He used it to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
The city is shaped like a square. It is as wide as it is long. He measured it with the rod. It was 12,000 stadia long, wide, and high.
He measured the wall too. It was 144 cubits, using the usual human measure, which is also the angel’s measure.
The wall was made of jasper. The city was pure gold, clear like glass.
The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald.
The fifth was onyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each gate was made from one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, clear like glass.
I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it. God’s glory gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The nations will walk by its light. The kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
Its gates will never be shut during the day, and there will be no night there.
They will bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
Nothing unclean will ever enter it. No one who does evil or tells lies will enter, except those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life. It was clear as crystal, and it flowed from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

It ran down the middle of the city’s main street. On each side of the river stood the tree of life. It produces twelve kinds of fruit, giving its fruit every month. Its leaves are for healing the nations.
There will be no more curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and His servants will serve Him.
They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will shine on them. They will reign forever and ever.
The angel said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must happen soon.”
“Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!
Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
Let the one who does wrong keep doing wrong. Let the filthy person stay filthy. Let the righteous person keep doing right. Let the holy person stay holy.”
“Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with Me, and I will give to each person according to what he has done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city through its gates.
“Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” Let the one who is thirsty come. Let the one who wants the water of life take it freely.
I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues written in this book.
And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are written about in this book.
He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
